rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Prohibits rental property owners from using coordinator services, coordinators from facilitating competition-restricting agreements, parallel pricing coordination, and performing coordinating functions for residential dwelling units in NJ.

rule.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rule.requirement: It shall be unlawful for a rental property owner or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of the services of a coordinator; for a coordinator to facilitate a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners that restricts competition with respect to residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function; for two or more persons to engage in or otherwise facilitate parallel pricing coordination; for any agent or representative of a coordinator or subcontractor thereof to engage in parallel pricing coordination; or for any person to perform a coordinating function.
rule.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful and a violation of the "New Jersey Antitrust Act," P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a. a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator
rule.key_value: Coordinator ban; parallel pricing coordination prohibition; competitively sensitive information sharing restriction
rule.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental property owners, coordinators, agents, representatives, and subcontractors using algorithmic devices in New Jersey for residential dwelling units
rule.exemptions: Research, statistical analysis, or testing without use in setting prices; public rent estimates at no cost; real estate brokerage databases available on equal terms that do not set prices or collect competitive information; government entities administering affordability controls
rule.sanctions: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act (P.L.1970, c.73); Attorney General enforcement; complaint mechanism established on Department of Law and Public Safety website
